y(prefix='serve-custody-') as temporary:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(temporary))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        assert rig.core.control.inbox.journal is rig.checkout.journal
        assert rig.core.restart.timers.journal is rig.checkout.journal
        captured = []
        def observe(frame, event, value):
            if event == 'return' and frame.f_code is triage.triage_pass.__code__:
                captured.append(frame.f_locals['driver'])
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        sys.setprofile(observe)
        try:
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
        [driver] = captured
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.journal.dir == rig.checkout.journal.dir
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        assert [event.body for event in rig.journal.read()] == [{'signal': 'triage_pass', 'pass': 0}]
        print('Confirmed on untouched base:', head)
        print('Production control and Timers share checkout.journal.')
        print('Original triage Driver and Effects use a separate Journal at the same directory.')
        print('Passive observation only; no replaced bindings, model calls or process calls in the graph.')
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == head
